decision_boundary: Selected after inspecting six of twelve AU/GG/WK calibration rows and before inspecting any LJ/OR holdout timing. The v1 unweighted loss was rejected because one 5.1e8-cycle calibration row dominated the cycle-SSE and produced 38 percent error on a small calibration row.
interpretation: The processed-edge term represents host/OpenCL shell work repeated for each realized edge and does not replace execution-driven FIFO, AXI, HBM, or backpressure timing. Relative weighting prevents the largest graph from deciding every coefficient.
